name: The three visions of the Lamdre

stages.name: impure vision
stages.description: Appearances of beings under the afflictions; contemplated as the faults of saṃsāra, leisure and endowment, death and karma to turn the mind.

stages.name: experiential vision
stages.description: Appearances to the yogin in concentration; love, compassion, bodhicitta and the meditative experiences of the path.

stages.name: pure vision
stages.description: The inexhaustible ornamental wheel of the Sugatas' body, speech and mind.

notes: Bands: the three visions are also taught as simultaneous perspectives, not only successive stages; banding is approximate.

name: The path through the grounds in the Vajra Verses

stages.name: path of accumulation
stages.description: Freed from the ordinary body, speech and mind by the four results; the elements gather.

stages.name: path of joining (heat, peak, patience, supreme dharma)
stages.description: The path of the inner buddhas reaching the peak of existence; patience of the unborn.

stages.name: first ground
stages.description: Marked by inner and outer signs (one finger-width of wind ceasing; drop stabilised).

stages.name: second to sixth grounds
stages.gloss: sa gnyis pa – sa drug pa
stages.description: Emanation-body qualities increase; six finger-widths of wind cease.

stages.name: seventh to tenth grounds
stages.gloss: sa bdun pa – sa bcu pa
stages.description: Enjoyment-body qualities; mastery of speech and teaching; ten finger-widths of wind cease.

stages.name: eleventh and twelfth grounds
stages.description: Dharmakāya qualities; twelve finger-widths of wind cease.

stages.name: twelve-and-a-half ground
stages.description: The life-wind enters the avadhūtī; the eight qualities of mastery arise.

stages.name: thirteenth ground, Vajradhara
stages.gloss: sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa

notes: Reconstructed from the terse Tibetan of Tōh 2284 (local); the signs belong to restricted completion-stage practice and are summarised only. Ground groupings follow markers in the root text ('sa drug', 'sa bcu', 'sa bcu gnyis', 'sa phyed dang bcu gsum', 'bcu gsum'); low confidence.

name: Parting from the Four Attachments as a path

stages.name: not attached to one's own purpose

notes: Bands approximate (bodhicitta placed in preparatory discipline; the view at first seeing).

name: The seven points of mind training

stages.name: main practice: the two bodhicittas
stages.gloss: ultimate (dream-like phenomena, resting in the nature) and relative (sending and taking)

stages.name: a lifetime's practice: the five powers

notes: A curriculum rather than a strict sequence: points 6–7 run alongside the rest; bands approximate.

name: The seven-point cause-and-effect sequence for bodhicitta

stages.name: bodhicitta
stages.description: When uncontrived, it marks entry into the Mahāyāna path of accumulation.

notes: All stages fall within preparatory discipline on the general band scale.

name: The three principal aspects as a path

stages.name: the correct view
stages.description: Dependent arising and emptiness understood together, not alternately.

stages.name: solitude and effort toward the final goal
